01.name: StartBattleSceneSubroutine
01.summary: Starts a battle scene subroutine and transfers control into a separate battle-state path.

02.name: WaitForActionScriptByteMatch
02.summary: Reads one inline match byte, then scans forward through the script until the current script byte matches it.

03.name: WaitForActionScriptChoiceByteMatch
03.summary: Reads inline result bytes, then scans forward through the script until the current script byte matches the selected action result slot.

04.name: AdvanceCursor
04.summary: Runs a small helper and advances the action script when the current step has completed.

05.name: DispatchPrimaryActionFamilyTable
05.summary: Dispatches the primary action-family table used by the common direct-attack script and related early family gates.

06.name: EnsureSelectedActionMetadata
06.summary: Ensures selected action metadata is present before later action steps run.

07.name: DispatchSecondaryActionFamilyTable
07.summary: Dispatches the secondary action-family table used by later offensive and utility family stages.

08.name: DispatchSupportRecoveryAndFollowupFamilyTable
08.summary: Dispatches the support, recovery, and follow-up family table.

09.name: DispatchFollowupSourceSequence
09.summary: Dispatches the follow-up source sequence used by counter/support-style flows.

0D.name: HandleDefenderFollowupFlags
0D.summary: Promotes current defender-side follow-up flags before later result-dependent branches.

11.name: SetAttackerAffinityResultFromSelectedAction
11.summary: Stores the attacker affinity/result classification from the selected action.

12.name: SetDefenderAffinityResultFromSelectedAction
12.summary: Stores the defender affinity/result classification from the selected action.

13.name: ComputeTotalRosPhase
13.summary: Computes total ROS for the current action and stores it in combat resolution scratch.

14.name: ResolveDefenderRosReductionsPhase
14.summary: Applies defender evasion and defense ROS reductions, including critical-hit bypass handling.

15.name: UpdateActionArgSelectorPhase
15.summary: Updates the current action argument selector from defender state before later conditional checks.

16.name: SeedPreDamageFromTotalRos
16.summary: Seeds pre-damage from total ROS by computing total_ros >> 2.

17.name: AccumulateBaseDamage
17.summary: Builds accumulated damage from pre-damage, part power, range bonuses, Berserk/Laser branches, and defender reductions.

18.name: HandleActionScriptOpcode1C
18.summary: Checks current follow-up/result state and stores a small action result code.

19.name: HandleActionScriptOpcode1D
19.summary: Uses current damage and threshold scratch to set an action-script result code.

1A.name: DispatchLateSupportRecoveryAndUtilityFamilyTable
1A.summary: Dispatches a later family table used by support, recovery, and utility action branches.

1C.name: HandleActionScriptOpcode1C
1C.summary: Checks current follow-up/result state and stores a small action result code.

1D.name: HandleActionScriptOpcode1D
1D.summary: Uses current damage/threshold scratch to set an action-script result code.

1E.name: ScaleDamageByPartScalar
1E.summary: Applies the selected part's damage scalar to the current damage scratch.

1F.name: DispatchSequenceTable4
1F.summary: Dispatches a later-stage outer action-sequence table.

24.name: RunPreviewSequenceUntilComplete
24.summary: Runs the left/right preview sequence until it marks completion.

25.name: ApplyDamageAndAdvancePreview
25.summary: Applies part damage during a preview/state step and advances the script.

00.familySummary: Shared direct-attack family gate used by sword-style attacks.
00.sharedScriptSummary: Shared direct-attack bytecode used by action ids 0x00..0x09. This is the real script for Sword, Hammer, Rifle, Chain Gun, Laser, Beam, Missile, Napalm, Break, and Press.
actualFlow: Dispatch late support/recovery/utility family table when the script branches there
Continue into end-of-action dispatch and preview/result phases
notes: Uses the shared direct-attack pipeline after the family gate.
Damage and overflow logic is mostly shared later.

01.familySummary: Shared direct-attack family gate used by hammer-style attacks.
01.sharedScriptSummary: Hammer shares the same direct-attack script as Sword through Press. The script itself is a branchy opcode stream: 0x04 setup/validation dispatch, 0x05 primary family gate, 0x06 metadata ensure, 0x07 secondary family gate, 0x08 support/recovery gate, 0x0B..0x17 combat math, 0x1E part-scalar damage scale, and later 0x1F end-of-action dispatch. Distinct Hammer behavior comes from the family gate and the Berserk damage branch, not a unique action script.
actualFlow: Fight_AdvanceActionScriptCursor resets the current opcode substate byte to 0 before each new opcode
Opcode 0x04 dispatches an early validation/setup substate table keyed by the opcode substate byte
Secondary/support family dispatch opcodes branch by matching inline label bytes >= 0x80
Accumulate base damage with the Berserk addend
Set action-script result from current damage/threshold state
Continue into late family dispatch and end-of-action handling
notes: Berserk-family damage bonus is applied later in shared damage accumulation.
